Over a special session, the desk staff reviewed an idea about seating plans, and we are sorry that your complaint concerns the handling of a companion animal during a delayed departure and the stress this caused for you and your pet. We understand that a delay can disrupt careful travel preparations, and our staff should keep every step clear, calm, and respectful.

<<FACT F109>> Please keep all receipts and service records together so we can complete the file without further delay. If you have already submitted the travel details, the next step is for our team to confirm the record and continue the review under the standard process. If any document is missing, send it through the same channel used for the original report so the case remains attached to your file.

Our ground team is instructed to move carriers carefully between services and to use steady handling at every stage. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and that standard applies whether the journey is short or extended. If you were told something different during the disruption, we will note that in the service review and use it to improve the handoff process.

For future travel, please keep the carrier secured, make sure the pet's identification is visible, and keep comfort items accessible without opening the container during movement. These steps help the passenger coordinator and the ground team support the animal without added confusion. We also advise travelers to check in early enough for a calm handover, since delays can make routine care more difficult.

We regret the inconvenience and the worry this event caused, and we appreciate the chance to correct the matter through the proper channel. Your report will remain with the Companion Animal Travel Desk until the review is complete and the response has been issued.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
